description: Na₂FeC₅H₄(N₂O)₃ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pnnm space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to four N and two equivalent O atoms to form edge-sharing NaN₄O₂ octahedra. There are two shorter (2.49 Å) and two longer (2.53 Å) Na-N bond lengths. Both Na-O bond lengths are 2.49 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to four N and two equivalent O atoms to form edge-sharing NaN₄O₂ octahedra. All Na-N bond lengths are 2.50 Å. Both Na-O bond lengths are 2.53 Å. Fe is bonded in an octahedral geometry to five C and one N atom. There are a spread of Fe-C bond distances ranging from 1.91-1.93 Å. The Fe-N bond length is 1.66 Å. There are three inequivalent C sites. In the first C site, C is bonded in a linear geometry to one Fe and one N atom. The C-N bond length is 1.17 Å. In the second C site, C is bonded in a linear geometry to one Fe and one N atom. The C-N bond length is 1.17 Å. In the third C site, C is bonded in a linear geometry to one Fe and one N atom. The C-N bond length is 1.18 Å. There are four inequivalent N sites. In the first N site, N is bonded in a linear geometry to one Fe and one O atom. The N-O bond length is 1.15 Å. In the second N site, N is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to two Na and one C atom. In the third N site, N is bonded in a distorted linear geometry to one Na and one C atom. In the fourth N site, N is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to two equivalent Na and one C atom. There are two inequivalent H sites. In the first H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one O atom. The H-O bond length is 0.98 Å. In the second H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one O atom. The H-O bond length is 0.98 Å. There are two inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted water-like geometry to two Na and two H atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one N atom.
